beginner: shape, value, color, light, material, and composition vocabulary
senior: protects hierarchy and authored identity across disciplines
balances artistic intent with runtime and pipeline constraints
recognizes genericness and weak reference transfer
lead_director: sets canon, selection criteria, review cadence, and tradeoffs
knows when to reject production and return to visual development

failure_patterns.repair: restore value separation with motivated fill, exposure control, surface response, and readable background structure
design environment around subject purpose, landmarks, scale cues, and narrative function
derive effect shape, timing, density, and color from the visual thesis and gameplay/scene purpose

symptoms: valid mesh/material but weak silhouette and light response
failure_patterns.repair: return to silhouette, proportion, value, and controlled neutral/grazing/production renders

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2
transfers: evidence discipline and testable criteria are analogous to separating objective and subjective claims

sources.title: Blender Manual: Color Management
transfers: version-specific color-management reference; revalidate when Blender changes

sources.title: Unreal Engine Documentation
transfers: engine behavior and feature maturity must be checked against installed version

known_limits: No script can certify taste, originality, emotion, or professional appeal.
Existing Blender and Unreal operations prove infrastructure and bounded production tasks, not broad art mastery.

cross_pack_links.relationship: Art direction sets the visual thesis and quality bar that all other packs execute within. It defines the relationships between composition, typography, motion, and interaction.

micro_labs.goal: Create a visual direction board with 3 distinct references, anti-references, and a written thesis
micro_labs.success: thesis is specific enough to guide decisions across disciplines

micro_labs.goal: Produce 3 materially different visual directions for the same subject, with distinct composition, value, color, and typographic strategies
micro_labs.success: each direction feels like a different product/world, not recolors

micro_labs.goal: Audit a project for cross-discipline coherence: does typography, motion, and interaction language match the art direction thesis?
micro_labs.success: identify 3+ coherence breaks with causal explanation

transfer_tests.goal: Apply the same visual thesis to a different medium (e.g., game environment to editorial website)
transfer_tests.success: identity survives medium change, principles transfer, result is distinct from original

golden_tasks.description: Given a visual direction, critique its thesis clarity, reference selection, and cross-discipline coherence
golden_tasks.evidence: structured critique with thesis evaluation and discipline-specific observations

golden_tasks.description: Given a direction, identify what styles/patterns it is NOT and explain the boundary
golden_tasks.evidence: clear anti-reference list with rationale for each exclusion

provenance_note: Authored from model knowledge. Requires KAPIF research evidence before canon eligibility.
